title: Quenched Snappy Vietnamese Tofu Noodles
description: A refreshing Vietnamese dish featuring snappy noodles, briny flavors, and vegetarian-friendly ingredients, perfect for a brunch mood

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the rice noodles to the pot and cook according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat some oil over medium heat and add the cubed tofu.
Cook the tofu until it is golden brown and crispy on all sides.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, smoked paprika, and lime juice.
Add the grated carrot to the pan with the tofu and cook until it is slightly tender.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan with the tofu and carrot, and pour in the soy sauce mixture.
Stir everything together and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
